name: Force Cube
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You conjure a cube of magical force in a space within long range. Roll Lore. The result becomes the Difficulty and also determines the maximum length of each side of the cube, in feet.

Any creature or object fully enclosed by the cube when it appears is trapped inside and cannot leave it by non-magical means.

Any creature partially within the cube when it forms must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a pass, the creature is pushed to the nearest space outside the cube. On a failure, the creature is forced fully inside the cube.

The cube may be opaque or translucent (your choice). Sound and spells cannot pass through it.

Describe how you conjure the cube.
successes:
✨: Dexterity rolls made to avoid being trapped when the cube appears are ill-favored.

✨: Increase the maximum length of each side of the cube by 5 ft.

🌞: The cube also blocks magical and phased-out movement.

💀: The spell misfires around you. Check a Condition and roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a pass, you evade the effect. On a failure, you are encased in a membrane of force, unable to move or take actions until the membrane is broken by at least 1 damage.
